meta.title: Sign in
meta.description: Sign in to ClippingKK to open your library of Kindle highlights.

page.title: Your reading life, in one quiet place.
page.description: Sign in to return to your books, your highlights and the ideas you meant to keep.
page.quote: The passages you marked are still here, waiting where you left them.

card.title: Sign in to ClippingKK
card.description: ClippingKK uses your Evonia Gate account to sign you in. Your books and highlights stay here.
card.legacy: Used to sign in with a phone number, WeChat, a wallet or a different Apple email? <link>Contact support</link> to verify and recover your old account.

errors.EMAIL_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED: Verify your email in Gate, then try again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: Your ClippingKK access has been removed. Contact support to restore access.
errors.ACCOUNT_RECOVERY_REQUIRED: We could not safely link your existing account. Contact support to recover your clippings.
errors.BAD_REQUEST: Your sign-in link expired. Please start again.
errors.LOGIN_FAILED: We could not complete sign-in with Gate. Please try again in a moment.
errors.GATE_NOT_CONFIGURED: ClippingKK sign-in is not configured correctly. Please try again later.
errors.generic: Sign-in could not be completed. Please try again.
